summarize_pytest_report: summarize a pytest JSON report file and return failure counts grouped by file, class, test name, and modeling key
run_pytest_helpers_cli: run pytest_helpers.py CLI with --report flag to print a formatted summary of test outcomes and failures
test_base_test_name: test the _base_test_name function that strips parametrized brackets from a pytest nodeid string
test_class_name: test the _class_name function that extracts the class name from a pytest nodeid string
test_modeling_key: test the _modeling_key function that extracts the model identifier from a test_modeling_xxx.py filename
